brief.text: Closed-end funds represent a heavy concentration of today's activity, highlighted by BPRE's $32.8 million cluster buy and three separate fund additions by Saba Capital Management in LEO, MXF, and DSM. Borr Drilling (BORR) recorded the largest overall transaction value at $57.1 million across three insiders, while Fuller H B Co (FUL) stood out for breadth with eight separate insiders making purchases totaling $1.12 million. Additionally, Rapport Therapeutics (RAPP) drew five distinct insiders totaling $1.57 million, led by director Steven M. Paul's $974,278 acquisition.
